name: Akoori on Toast
subtitle: soft-scrambled spiced eggs piled on buttered toast
prepNotes: Akoori should pour slightly rather than hold its shape. Creamy, not raw: bring it to 71°C / 160°F and no further.
Everything else is cooked before the eggs go anywhere near the pan.

steps.text: Soften the onion in the butter, add the ginger, green chilli and turmeric and cook 2 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook just until it slumps, 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the cream and salt and pour them in over low heat.
Stir slowly and constantly, taking the pan off the heat every few seconds.
steps.tip: Off the heat repeatedly. That is how you get curds this soft.

steps.text: Pull it off while still visibly wet, fold in the coriander and pile onto the hot toast.
steps.tip: It carries on cooking on the plate. Wet in the pan is right.

storage: Eat immediately. Scrambled eggs do not keep or reheat.
